# Script Toolbox

> Configurable script toolbox and UI builder for Maya, Nuke, and Houdini.

This file is the LLM-oriented entry point for the current stable Script Toolbox contract on `main`. The current configuration schema is 21.

For requests to create a Script Toolbox template, preset, reusable UI block, or importable configuration, read the authoring specification first.

## Critical output rule

When a user asks for a template to copy/paste, insert, or use with **Import from Clipboard**, default to a strict JSON Item/subtree whose top-level object contains `"kind"`.

Do **not** output the built-in preset-registry wrapper with `id/dcc/category/label/description/root` unless the user explicitly asks for repository source code or a built-in Presets-palette entry.

Clipboard JSON must use JSON literals `true`, `false`, and `null`; never Python `True`, `False`, or `None`.

## LLM authoring

- [Template / preset authoring specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/docs/developer/llm-template-authoring.md): canonical machine-oriented guide for clipboard Items, preset definitions, item subtrees, bindings, and complete configuration documents.
- [Current architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): schema, item registry, layout and section semantics, runtime contracts.
- [Item guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/docs/guide/items.md): user-facing overview of built-in item types.
- [Scripting guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/docs/guide/scripting.md): bindings, script languages, names and references.

## Hosts

- [Nuke](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/docs/NUKE.md)
- [Houdini](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/docs/HOUDINI.md)

## Source-of-truth code

- [Config version](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/scripts/script_toolbox/constants.py)
- [Universal item model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/scripts/script_toolbox/model/items.py)
- [Built-in item definitions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/scripts/script_toolbox/model/item_builtins.py)
- [Preset registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/scripts/script_toolbox/core/presets.py)
- [Clipboard/config transfer parser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/scripts/script_toolbox/core/config.py)
- [Binding contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/main/scripts/script_toolbox/model/bindings.py)

Repository-aware agents working on `dev` or another branch must inspect that branch's source before authoring. If `CONFIG_VERSION` differs from the version stated here, treat the checked-out source as newer and do not invent a migration.
